Home.title: One project: QR menu, reservations, and SEO website.
Home.body: This architecture starts with the customer QR menu and is ready to expand into reservation management and full back-office CMS. Public pages stay SEO friendly while staff tools are isolated in admin routes.
Home.heroDescription: An authentic Mexican corner in the heart of Alcântara, Lisboa — homestyle recipes, craft margaritas, and warm hospitality that keeps you coming back.
Home.discountBannerBody: 🎉 For the first 20 customers who book their table online!
Home.qrBody: Customer-facing mobile menu route, ideal for table QR codes and quick updates.
Home.reservationBody: Online booking form connected to API endpoints, ready for database and notifications.
Home.seoBody: Server-rendered pages for Google discovery while reusing the same content model.
